newsitem.title: USA: SEC fines muni limited partnership head $50,000.
newsitem.headline: SEC fines muni limited partnership head $50,000.

text.p: SEC on Tuesday said it fined the head of a Cincinnati broker-dealer $50,000 for not telling buyers of $19 million in muni limited partnership interests that he used some of their funds for other purposes.

The Securities and Exchange Commission said George Meyers, the sole shareholder in Fox, Reusche & Co., failed to tell investors that he used part of the assets of Tax Exempt Fund for investments "other than municipal bonds and short-term accounts."
SEC said Meyers' son Gregory, general partner of Municipal Fund limited partnership, also failed to make the disclosures.
George Meyers sold a total of $19 million in partnership interests and his son sold $1.5 million, SEC said.
The Meyers neither admitted or denied the bulk of SEC's findings, SEC said.
George Meyers was unavailable for comment. Gregory Meyers said he had no comment.
